hero.title: A support network that's actually here to help
hero.body: When you first leave school you'll start to notice where a network really starts to count, whether that's an internship at a big firm, or just being called for a nixer in your neighbourhood. Every person has a network which impacts them, and their work in a certain way.
hero.body2: Once you're signed in you can see the directory in full across a range of industries; ask questions about the job or the work involved in getting it. The volunteers are here to help, not to tell you what to do.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.body: Put your invitation code in below along with your passcode to gain access to the directory today
signup.email_hint: Use your personal email to make sure you can keep your access

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Put your email in below and you'll receive your sign in link via email

directory.title: Network
directory.body: Everyone listed here is a willing volunteer, feel free to reach out to them and see what they can do to help.

routes.title: How to join
routes.body: The network is limited to adults who are students or alumni approved by the website. If your school isn't registered yet feel free to reach out to them and put us in touch!
routes.student_body: Ask your guidance counsellor for a link to join. Over 18s are verified by school staff before being given their passkey
routes.past_body: Were you a student with one of our partner schools? Reach out to them to claim your passkey and we can get you set up on our platform.
routes.nothing_body: Email us and let us know which school you went to, and we'll reach out to them.
